notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hi! 

Small patch that adds support for keyboard controls when a gamepad is connected.
This should hopefully alleviate a little bit of friction when playing with a steam deck docked.
(A second gamepad would also work!) 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119160/b44174406662e775081f315297261e8d0b813dab.png"]

Keyboard controls are as usual

Arrow keys
Primary button: z/c
Secondary: x/v
End turn: Space

/ Sebastian

notes.title: 1.1.0 Tricky update
notes.notes:
Hi! 


With this update I wanted to create some levels with the Pull card that gets introduced in the endless mode.
Expect some tricky levels where you need to use all the tricks on your arsenal to finish all of them! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119160/31dc90507056ecb95cb688fb581e42755543d533.png"]

I also introduced a new "sneak peek" mechanic. 
You can now see your upcoming turns by hovering over your deck. 
This is especially handy in the Tricky and the Endless mode!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119160/c7e8a072abf512ee9f6c161a17d078250ad8ef15.png"]
Hope you have fun and stay awesome!

/ Sebastian
